MAIN FINDING - the sparseness is real, not an extraction failure. This package is 55 near-independent MonoBehaviours that all couple to EXTERNAL types (LeanTouch, LeanGesture, LeanFingerData, LeanSelectable, LeanSelectByFinger, LeanFingerFilter, LeanScreenDepth, LeanScreenQuery, CwEditor) in the sibling LeanTouch/LeanCommon/CW.Common assemblies, and to each other almost not at all. Components are composed via UnityEvent wiring in the Inspector, which leaves no code trace. A denser graph would require fabrication.
